title: Route metadata kwargs to matching sub-estimator method in BaggingClassifier predict_proba
answers: Why is metadata routing failing in BaggingClassifier predict_proba when base estimators lack predict_proba?
How should metadata parameters be routed to base estimators in BaggingClassifier.predict_proba?
TypeError unexpected keyword argument in BaggingClassifier predict_proba with metadata routing
body:
Symptom: Metadata routed to sub-estimators in BaggingClassifier.predict_proba is passed to the wrong method or rejected with unexpected keyword arguments.
Root cause: sklearn/ensemble/_bagging.py:_parallel_predict_proba passed predict_params to estimator.predict_proba and predict_proba_params to fallback estimator.predict.
Fix pattern: Pass method-specific routed metadata kwargs to the method actually invoked (predict_proba_params to predict_proba, predict_params to predict).
Constraints: Applies to composite estimators dynamically routing metadata to sub-estimator methods based on estimator capabilities.
